raw_text: Urgent update from Khartoum: RSF forces advancing from multiple directions. Heavy weapons fire near Al-Mogran area where Blue and White Nile meet. SAF deploying armored vehicles from barracks. Residents trapped in homes with no safe evacuation routes. Power outages reported in Bahri district. Medical facilities overwhelmed with casualties.
clean_text: RSF advancing from multiple directions in Khartoum. Heavy fire near Al-Mogran. SAF deploying armor. Residents trapped, power outages in Bahri. Medical facilities overwhelmed.
